title: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF A CHANGE TO AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 7] <Amended 2017.3.9>

APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF A CHANGE TO AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS

(Front)

| Receipt number | Date of receipt | Processing period |
|---|---|---|
| ____________________ | ____________________ | 14 days |

| Section | Field | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Applicant | Name of corporation or institution | ____________________ |
| | Representative's name | ____________________ |
| | Date of birth | ____________________ |
| | Address | ____________________ (Telephone number: ____________________) |
| Changes | Before change | ____________________ |
| | After change | ____________________ |

I hereby apply for registration of a change to an instrumentation business pursuant to Article 22(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 12(2) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 8(3) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Mayor/Do Governor

ATTACHMENTS

| Category | Documents to be submitted by the applicant | Matters to be verified by the public official in charge |
|---|---|---|
| Change to the trade name or the location of the principal place of business or a branch | None | Certification of business registration or a certificate of registered corporate particulars (only in the case of a corporation) |
| Change to the corporation's representative or executive officers | A list of the new representative or executive officers | Certificate of registered corporate particulars |
| Change to technical personnel | A list of the new technical personnel and their construction technology career certificates (only where verification of practical experience is necessary) | National technical qualification certificates of the new technical personnel |
| Change to equipment held | A specification of the changed instrumentation equipment and 1 copy of the performance inspection reports for the instrumentation equipment | None |

Fee: 20,000 won

CONSENT TO THE JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

I consent to the public official in charge verifying the matters listed above for official verification, in connection with the processing of this matter, through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act.
* If consent is withheld, the applicant shall submit the relevant documents directly.

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

210 mm × 297 mm [white woodfree paper, 80 g/m²]

(Back)

PROCESSING PROCEDURE

This application is processed as follows.

| Applicant | Processing authority (Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province) |
|---|---|
| Submit application → | Receive application |
| | ↓ Review whether registration may be granted |
| | ↓ Approval |
| Certificate delivered to applicant ← | Issue registration certificate |
